description: issue #684 (slice I5): on_key is not a Core command — without the interaction-events profile it is rejected as ol-unknown-command (spec/interaction-events.md §Profiles and reservation: the event block-heads belong to the profile, and a profile decides whether such a word *works*). Together with on-key-visible-under-profile this proves the form end to end: profile active → checks clean; Core-only → rejected. Note this is the AVAILABILITY axis, which is legitimately profile-conditional, not the naming axis: whether a program may *declare* the name is unconditional (spec/grammar.md:408).
